_comment: Cost, routing, execution modes, CI policy and baseline assumptions for AI test runs. Env vars in .env.example override selected values.

pricing._comment: USD per million tokens. Edit to match your contract.

infrastructure._comment: Browser/tool charges. 0 for a local Chrome; set when using a hosted browser grid or paid tools.

routing._comment: Which model tier each role uses. 'economy' for routine execution, 'advanced' for reasoning-heavy work.

limits._comment: Run-level hard limits shared by all modes unless a mode overrides them.

smoke.description: Happy Path + critical approved regression scenarios. For pull requests.

regression.description: Happy Path + all approved regression scenarios. For merges, releases and manual runs.

exploratory.description: Happy Path + AI-chosen exploratory charters that propose new regression scenarios. Scheduled or manual.

ci._comment: Required-check policy. Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 verified failure, 2 incomplete (Blocked/Inconclusive), 3 infrastructure error.

baseline._comment: ASSUMPTIONS for a hand-written Playwright suite covering the same scenarios. Replace with your team's numbers; the AI side is measured.
